verdict.rationale: Superpowers is a harness-agnostic skills plugin that runs inside agents like Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI. A plugin of this kind could plausibly bundle or wire up MCP servers, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions MCP servers or any mechanism for connecting external tool servers. It covers only skills, slash commands, session-start injection and harness tool-name mapping, so there is no evidence this capability exists.
